contract: The proof file extension table. bosso's default allowed extensions are exactly the contentTypes keys, the proof host Worker serves each with its type, and bossd publishes media with exactly the daemonMedia extensions, each with its contentTypes type. Copied byte for byte to services/bossd/api/daemon/testdata/proof-extensions.json; scripts/release/user-uploads-worker.test.mjs compares the copies and the Worker.
